verdict.rationale: First-party IAM docs show Claude Code accepts an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable as an alternative to account login. The key is sent as the X-Api-Key header and skips the login prompt; interactive mode asks for a one-time approval that is remembered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API-key auth, and documentation of other key-supply methods or headless/CI edge cases.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: If you've set the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable, Claude Code skips the login prompt and asks you to approve the key instead.
Use this for direct Anthropic API access with a key from the Claude Console. In interactive mode, you are prompted once to approve or decline the key, and your choice is remembered.
